title: Consciousness is a causally emergent feature of neuron systems

statements.text: Consciousness is a causally emergent property of certain systems of neurons, as solidity and liquidity are emergent features of systems of molecules. Its existence is explained by the causal interactions of the brain at the micro level, but it cannot be deduced from the physical structure of neurons alone.

sources.locator: p. 6, quoting The Rediscovery of the Mind, p. 112
sources.quote: consciousness is a causally emergent property of systems
